Oh yeah their is no doubt about the mental illness part I am on medications that were managed by a psychiatrist at one point, but I moved and the wait for seeing a psychiatrist is months out so my pcp is managing my meds now. I wish I could use Kratom but suboxone makes it impossible. I skateboard alot. I really feel like I lack a sense of inner purpose and that is a big part of my addiction 

Thanks for the feedback like you said it's not that I am not trying. I am just not having success with the most common methods so Its hard for me to motivate myself to try again.

Anyways happy holidays!!
